summary: Tested the probabilistic Revenue Forecast (Monte Carlo) end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass against /api/analytics/forecasting (with & without target) and /api/analytics/forecast-narrative. Frontend: /forecast renders with all required data-testids, real P10/P50/P90 numbers ($866k / $975k / $1.077M), fan chart with shaded band + dashed recurring baseline, Claude-generated narrative, Data Sources panel, Quarterly outlook, Top Deals table. Target probability flow works (target=800000 -> 97.6%, target=1000 -> 100%). PostHog script removed as expected (Useberry + Termly still present).

integration_issues.issue: When the target input is changed and 'Check' is clicked in quick succession (small delay), the previous target's result can remain displayed if a new fetch aborts. Not reproducible with normal user speed; backend returns correct probability (verified via pytest for 99999999 -> ~0%).

issues: React hydration warnings in console: '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>' and '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' emitted by the Emergent visual-edits babel plugin wrapping the Top Deals table rows with a <span display:contents>. NOT app code — noted so it isn't misinterpreted as a Recharts/table bug.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/analytics.py is very large (~1000+ lines). Consider extracting _compute_forecast() Monte Carlo helpers into a dedicated forecasting service module for readability and unit-testability.

Goal probability is returned as a percentage (0-100) while other percentage-like fields (e.g. probabilities in stage_forecast) may use 0-1 elsewhere — audit for consistency to avoid frontend rendering mistakes.
public/index.html scripts: PostHog cleanly removed, Termly + Useberry intact — no regression.
test_credentials: testpro@test.com / password (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — Enterprise owner with seeded demo CRM data)
seed_data_creation: None — used existing testpro@test.com demo data (has deals so forecast populates).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth uses httpOnly session_token cookie (NOT bearer token). Backend tests must use requests.Session() with login POST first; the cookie will be attached automatically. The forecast /api/analytics/forecasting?target=X returns a 'goal' object where probability is a PERCENTAGE (0-100), not 0-1. Frontend hydration warnings for the top-deals-table originate from the Emergent visual-edits plugin (not the RevenueForecast code) and can be safely ignored unless a plugin update is made.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking issues found. The previously reported naive/aware datetime crash in _parse_dt is confirmed fixed (all Monte Carlo endpoints return 200 with valid P10<=P50<=P90 payloads).
